maddeler.e:
نتحالف (form VI)
# نَتَحَالَفُ (nataḥālafu) /na.ta.ħaː.la.fu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَحَالَفَ (taḥālafa)
# نَتَحَالَفَ (nataḥālafa) /na.ta.ħaː.la.fa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَحَالَفَ (taḥālafa)
# نَتَحَالَفْ (nataḥālaf) /na.ta.ħaː.laf/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَحَالَفَ (taḥālafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
